title.narrative: Bridging the Justice Gap: Empowering Human Rights Defenders to Advance Access to Justice for Women

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen the capacity of women human rights defenders to effectively promote and protect the rights of women, minorities, and other vulnerable groups in the criminal justice system; to provide holistic support for women, girls and other marginalized groups who come in conflict with law; to promote collaboration and solidarity among women legal defenders, HRD¿s, and pro bono lawyers; to promote reforms aimed at eliminating gender-based violence and discrimination against women in the criminal justice system; and to increase public awareness about women¿s rights and mobilize support among men and boys to end gender-based violence and discrimination against women.

project recordsQuality control comment August 2023 This values of 2326 605 female and 1721 male has been set to 0. Final report. The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.

title.narrative: Extent to which the need for protection for HRDs at risk is recognised and addressed by national authorities

description.narrative: By the end of the project, there will be an observable shift in the recognition and response of national authorities towards the protection needs of Human Rights Defenders (HRDs) at risk. This will be evidenced by an increased level of collaboration and engagement between national authorities and HRD protection mechanisms, such as the establishment or improvement of protocols, dialogue forums, or dedicated units aimed at addressing the safety concerns of HRDs.
